products.short_description: Turn software discovery into a reconciled license position — pull installed-software data from Configuration Manager, Intune, or Flexera, normalize it, map it to entitlements, and produce the reconciliation that drives compliance and reharvesting. products.description:
Turn raw software discovery into a clean, reconciled license position

Discovery tools tell you what's installed — but raw inventory is noisy: thousands of unnormalized titles, editions and versions that don't map to SKUs, and no link to what you actually bought. This solution turns software discovery into a reconciled license position: pull installed-software data from Configuration Manager, Intune, or a discovery tool like Flexera, normalize it, map it to entitlements, and produce the reconciliation that drives compliance and reharvesting.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the discovery sources (Configuration Manager, Intune, Flexera), software normalization and SKU mapping, the entitlement reconciliation model, and how the output feeds compliance and optimization.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a discovery source with inventory enabled, access/export rights, an entitlement system of record, a normalization approach) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Vendor-specific Flexera setup is deferred to the vendor's documentation.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable/confirm inventory, export installed-software data, normalize titles/editions/versions, map to entitlements, reconcile and flag exceptions, then pilot, validate, and expand to more sources.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — installed-software discovery (Intune/Configuration Manager), normalization/mapping validation, a reconciliation and exception report, safe remediation of mapping gaps, and a discovery-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Raw software discovery turned into a clean, reconciled license position — normalized, mapped to entitlements, exceptions flagged — the foundation for compliance and reharvesting, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SWDISC-Discovery.ps1 — installed-software discovery from Intune, Configuration Manager, or a Flexera export
    • SWDISC-Remediation.ps1 — safely apply queued normalization-map fixes for unmatched titles (default -WhatIf)
    • SWDISC-Report.ps1 — build the reconciliation ledger (installed vs entitled per SKU) and the exception register
    • SWDISC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/confirm the pilot "Discovery Scope Group - Pilot Source - Pilot"
    • SWDISC-Validation.ps1 — confirm raw inventory normalizes to SKUs and the entitlement register shares the SKU vocabulary

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
